يقتطفون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَطِفُونَ (yaqtaṭifūna) /jaq.ta.tˤi.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# يُقْتَطَفُونَ (yuqtaṭafūna) /juq.ta.tˤa.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
